name: Valco Baby Travel System Adapters – Snap Ultra Trend
seatBrandsSupported: Maxi-Cosi / Nuna / Cybex / Clek — the Clek Liing is explicitly supported (retailer listings, e.g. Snuggle Bugz, title it 'Ultra Trend Adapter – Maxi Cosi/Nuna/Cybex/Clek', and it is the exact part A9904 named on Clek's official compatibility list).

status.clekNote: Named on Clek's Liing/Liingo list as 'Travel System Adapters – Snap Ultra Trend', part A9904.

install.pieces: pair of clamp-on adapter arms (left + right)
install.notes: Clamp onto the Snap Ultra Trend frame side-rails; the infant car seat clicks into the arms. Remove seat, then clip in car seat to form the travel system.

notes: This is the exact adapter Clek names for the Valco Snap Ultra Trend (part A9904). Supports the Clek Liing (plus Maxi-Cosi/Nuna/Cybex). Price runs ~$60 (Bambi Baby) to ~$80 (ANB Baby), both in stock. Do NOT confuse with the Snap DUO Trend adapter (A9905) or the Snap 4 Trend adapter — those are for the double/quad Valco strollers, not the Snap Ultra Trend. Image is the Valco Snap-series car-seat adapter from the Mega Babies listing (representative of A9904).
